summary: This note records the Italian censorship decision on the 1960 film "Le pillole di Ercole". The Committee for the Theatrical Review of the Italian Ministry of Cultural Heritage and Activities rated it VM16, meaning not suitable for children under 16. The committee also ordered specific scenes and lines cut or shortened, and the decision was documented as N° 32710, signed on 3 September 1960 by Minister Renzo Helfer.
one_line: Record of the 1960 Italian censorship ruling on the film "Le pillole di Ercole", including its VM16 rating and required cuts.
key_facts: "Le pillole di Ercole" was first released in Italy in 1960.
The Committee for the Theatrical Review of the Italian Ministry of Cultural Heritage and Activities rated "Le pillole di Ercole" VM16.
A VM16 rating means the film is not suitable for children under 16.
The committee required the scene in which Manfredi and Koscina hug each other on the bed to be shortened.
The committee required the scene in which Manfredi makes a house call to Valerie (reel 4) to be modified.
The committee required the lines in which De Sica says "...I know, when I am with a woman..." until "...a hay barn" to be deleted.
Document N° 32710 was signed on 3 September 1960 by Minister Renzo Helfer.
The censorship decision was issued by the Committee for the Theatrical Review of the Italian Ministry of Cultural Heritage and Activities.
